shots.alt: “Quickly, who’s got a birthday coming up?” and a screenshot of an iPhone showing two widgets: one with the title “Birthdays in the next 3 days” and showing a person’s name and their birthday as today, and another person whose birthday is two days from now, and the second with the title “Upcoming Birthdays” showing three people’s names birthdays and ages (including one today)

forget?
shots.alt: “Don’t you hate it when you forget?” and a screenshot of an iPhone showing a Settings screen for setting notifications, allowing the user to toggle each of: “on the day”, “one day before”, and “a few days before”. There is also a selector to set how many days before, and the time for the notification.
